name: Schools 3 v 3 (junior)
notes: Assumed common Victorian schools format: three speakers, no reply, short preparation. Check against the competition's rules.

name: Schools 3 v 3 (senior)
notes: Longer speeches and preparation for senior students.

name: Small group 2 v 2
notes: For small groups: the 2nd speaker also does the 3rd speaker's job (rebuttal and summary).

name: One on one
notes: For two or three students: one speaker a side, each with a reply; a third student adjudicates.
